questions.stem: Use the source tree: if x₁≤10, stop at leaf [3,5,7]; otherwise test x₂≤5, whose true leaf is [10,14,18] and false leaf is [30,40]. Each leaf predicts its unweighted target mean. Evaluate samples A=(10,100), B=(12,5) and C=(12,6), in that order. Which option gives both the predictions (A,B,C) and whether the x₂ test is reached for each sample?
assumptions: The tree is transcribed from the printed figure; evaluate each sample independently; features and targets are dimensionless toy quantities; no missing-value or pruning rule is introduced.

citations.locator: Assignment physical page 26: Week 6 item 8, complete regression-tree figure in the lower half of the page
citations.evidenceText: Root x1≤10: true→[3,5,7]; false→test x2≤5, true→[10,14,18], false→[30,40].

citations.locator: Assignment physical page 27: Week 6 item 8 continuation, worked route and leaf-mean rule at the top of the page
citations.evidenceText: The source follows reached tests in order and predicts the mean of target values in the selected leaf.

solution.justification: A tree follows only the branch actually reached. Equality belongs to the true side of each displayed ≤ test, and prediction uses the selected leaf’s mean rather than its sum.

optionExplanations.o1: A satisfies root equality and stops at the first leaf; B reaches and satisfies the second equality; C reaches the second false branch. The leaf means are 5,14,35.
optionExplanations.o2: This sends A past the root despite 10≤10, whether by changing ≤ to < or by testing x₂ unconditionally.
optionExplanations.o3: This sends B to the second false branch despite 5≤5.
optionExplanations.o4: The branch decisions are correct, but the predictions use leaf sums instead of means.

steps: A: 10≤10 is true, so stop at [3,5,7]; the x₂ test is not reached, regardless of A’s second coordinate. Prediction=(3+5+7)/3=5.
B: 12≤10 is false, then 5≤5 is true; prediction=(10+14+18)/3=14.
C: 12≤10 is false, then 6≤5 is false; prediction=(30+40)/2=35.

variables.n: number of training targets in that leaf
variables.yᵢ: training target in the selected leaf
